title: Slash Debuts New Song ‘Flying Blind’ Featuring Myles Kennedy on Octane
summary: The new song will debut on the SiriusXM channel on October 1, with replays throughout the day.
body_markdown:
Listen to the exclusive world premiere of[Slash](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/slash) ‘s new song, “Flying Blind,” featurng[Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/myles-kennedy) on[Octane (Ch. 37)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/octane) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTheHuOctane?source=in_text) beginning at 2pm ET/11am ET on Thursday, October 1. The song will then air throughout the day on the channel.


[“Flying Blind” World Premiere Airing on Octane starting October 1 at 2pm ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogIceNineKillsPlayDeadOctane?source=streaming_banner)
